title: Saturday Quick Tip
subtitle: When a player arrives late
hook: A player shows up after warm-ups. Do they start?
intro: The game starts in five minutes.
statement: Kids rarely control their own ride.
q1: Do you hold a late player out for a few minutes —
q2: or play them as planned since it was not their choice?
t1: Every team is different. But the rule feels fair
t2: when everyone knows it before the season.
cta: Coaches — what is your late arrival rule?
ctaLines: Sit an inning. No rule. Talk to the parent.
Hold them out or play them?
ctaPrompt: Share your rule below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A player shows up after warm-ups. Do they start?
The game starts in five minutes. Your starter just arrived.
Kids rarely control their own ride.
Hold them out or play them as planned. There is no perfect answer.
What is your late arrival rule? Share your habit in the comments.
